papers.title: Processing optimization, microstructure, mechanical properties and nanoprecipitation behavior of 18Ni300 maraging steel in selective laser melting
papers.first_author_affiliation: Key Laboratory of Intelligent Manufacturing Technology, Ministry of Education, Shantou University, Shantou, 515063, China

corresponding_authors.name: Zhongfa Mao
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Key Laboratory of Intelligent Manufacturing Technology, Ministry of Education, Shantou University, Shantou, 515063, China

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究的是非生物医学材料（18Ni300马氏体时效钢）的选择性激光熔化工艺，未涉及多孔结构、应力遮挡或骨整合性能。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address biomedical implant applications, porous structures, stress shielding, fatigue behavior, or surface characteristics for osseointegration; it is focused on a non-biomedical alloy (maraging steel) for tooling applications.

summary_zh.motivation: 优化18Ni300马氏体时效钢SLM工艺，获得高致密度和优异力学性能
summary_zh.method: 系统研究激光功率、扫描速度等工艺参数对致密度、显微组织和力学性能的影响
summary_zh.result: 优化工艺下获得近全致密样品，抗拉强度达1200MPa，延伸率12%
summary_zh.validation: 通过SEM、EBSD和室温拉伸验证显微组织和力学性能

summary_en.motivation: Optimize selective laser melting parameters for 18Ni300 maraging steel to achieve full density and superior mechanical properties.
summary_en.method: Systematically investigated the effects of laser power, scanning speed, and hatch spacing on relative density, microstructure, and tensile properties.
summary_en.result: Nearly fully dense samples were obtained with ultimate tensile strength up to 1200 MPa and elongation of 12%.
summary_en.validation: Microstructure was characterized by SEM and EBSD, and mechanical properties were validated through room-temperature tensile tests.

papers.title: Effect of building orientation and heat treatment on the anisotropic tensile properties of AlSi10Mg fabricated by selective laser melting
papers.first_author_affiliation: Institute of Machinery Manufacturing Technology, China Academy of Engineering Physics, Mianyang 621900, China

corresponding_authors.name: G.W. Wang
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Institute of Machinery Manufacturing Technology, China Academy of Engineering Physics, Mianyang 621900, China

corresponding_authors.name: Xianfeng Shen
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Institute of Machinery Manufacturing Technology, China Academy of Engineering Physics, Mianyang 621900, China

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了AlSi10Mg合金的选区激光熔化工艺，但未涉及生物医学植入物相关的应力屏蔽、多孔结构或疲劳性能。
llm.why_not_core: No porous structure or stress shielding analysis, no fatigue testing, and material AlSi10Mg is not a common biomedical implant alloy.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究构建方向和热处理对SLM成型AlSi10Mg各向异性拉伸性能的影响
summary_zh.method: 通过改变构建方向和热处理条件，进行拉伸测试和微观结构分析
summary_zh.result: 构建方向和热处理显著影响拉伸性能和各向异性，热处理可降低各向异性
summary_zh.validation: 通过拉伸试验和微观组织表征验证

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the effect of building orientation and heat treatment on the anisotropic tensile properties of AlSi10Mg fabricated by selective laser melting.
summary_en.method: Tensile tests and microstructural analysis were conducted on specimens with different building orientations and heat treatment conditions.
summary_en.result: Building orientation and heat treatment significantly influence tensile properties and anisotropy, with heat treatment reducing anisotropy.
summary_en.validation: Validation through mechanical testing and microstructural characterization.

papers.title: Effects of scanning speeds on the wear behavior of CoCrW alloy fabricated by selective laser melting
papers.first_author_affiliation: Aerospace Research Institute of Materials and Processing Technology, 100076 Beijing, China

corresponding_authors.name: Chaofang Dong
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Beijing Advanced Innovation Center for Materials Genome Engineering, Institute for Advanced Materials and Technology, University of Science and Technology Beijing, Beijing 100083, China

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究LPBF工艺参数对CoCrW合金磨损性能的影响，方法可迁移至生物医学植入物疲劳或表面性能研究，但未涉及多孔结构或应力遮挡。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address porous structures, stress shielding, stiffness matching, fatigue testing, or osseointegration; it focuses only on wear behavior under different scanning speeds.

summary_zh.motivation: 探究扫描速度对选区激光熔化CoCrW合金磨损性能的影响
summary_zh.method: 制备不同扫描速度的CoCrW样品，进行磨损测试并分析微观结构
summary_zh.result: 扫描速度影响显微硬度和磨损率，存在优化区间
summary_zh.validation: 通过磨损试验和SEM表征验证

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the effect of scanning speed on the wear resistance of CoCrW alloy fabricated by selective laser melting for potential biomedical applications.
summary_en.method: CoCrW samples were fabricated at varying scanning speeds, followed by wear testing and microstructural analysis.
summary_en.result: Scanning speed significantly affects microhardness and wear rate, with an optimal range identified.
summary_en.validation: Validation through wear experiments and SEM characterization.

papers.title: Molecular Dynamics Simulations of the Tensile Mechanical Responses of Selective Laser-Melted Aluminum with Different Crystalline Forms
papers.abstract: The mechanical deformation of cellular structures in the selective laser melting (SLM) of aluminum was investigated by performing a series of molecular dynamics (MD) simulations of uniaxial tension tests. The effects of crystalline form, temperature, and grain orientation of columnar grains on the mechanical properties of SLM aluminum were examined. The MD results showed that the tensile strength of SLM aluminum with columnar grains at different temperatures was lower than that of single-crystal aluminum, but greater than that of aluminum with equiaxed grains. The tensile strength and Young’s modulus both decreased approximately linearly upon increasing the temperature. The deformation mechanisms of equiaxed and columnar grains included dislocation slip, grain boundary migration, and torsion, while the deformation mechanisms of single crystals included stacking fault formation and amorphization. Finally, the influence of the columnar grain orientation on the mechanical properties was studied, and it was found that the Young’s modulus was almost independent of the grain orientation. The tensile strength was greatly affected by the columnar grain orientation. Reasonable control of the grain orientation can improve the tensile strength of SLM aluminum.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究的是SLM铝材的分子动力学力学性能，与生物医学植入物、应力遮挡、疲劳或骨整合无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on molecular dynamics simulations of SLM aluminum, not on biomedical implant materials, stress shielding, fatigue testing, or osseointegration.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究SLM铝在不同晶型下的拉伸力学行为
summary_zh.method: 采用分子动力学模拟柱状晶、等轴晶和单晶铝的单轴拉伸
summary_zh.result: 柱状晶强度低于单晶但高于等轴晶，强度和模量随温度线性下降

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the tensile mechanical behavior of selective laser-melted aluminum with varying crystalline forms.
summary_en.method: Molecular dynamics simulations of uniaxial tension were performed on columnar, equiaxed, and single-crystal aluminum.
summary_en.result: Columnar grains exhibited lower strength than single crystals but higher than equiaxed grains; strength and modulus decreased linearly with temperature.
summary_en.validation: No experimental validation was performed; results are purely computational.
